title: Scope Growth Points on Restart Re-Pricing — Professional Services Projects
content:
**Professional Services Projects — restart re-pricing and earlier scope additions.**

When the client has signed two or more scope additions on the engagement, 1.0 point is added to the restart re-pricing, 0.5 point when it has signed exactly one, and none otherwise.

| Signed scope additions on the engagement | Points added |
|---|---|
| two or more | 1.0 |
| exactly one | 0.5 |
| none | none |

Only change orders of the scope addition kind in signed status count; scope reductions, schedule changes and change orders that lapsed, were withdrawn or were rejected do not.
